# Interview P2: accountant, joined in spring

Date: 2026-10-22. In the office, 25 minutes.

He does the smaller clients, about fifteen of them, at month end.

"Honestly the copying is the worst part. I select the table, paste it, and then fix the minus signs."

The pasted amounts sometimes arrive as text, so his spreadsheet totals are off until he fixes them.

"I always filter to one client first, otherwise the table is far too long."

He mentioned the reports page loads slowly on Mondays but was not sure why.

"Sometimes I just give up and type the numbers in myself."
